job.title: Technical Engineering Project Manager
job.description:
We are looking to fill an exciting position with a worldwide leading manufacturer of military and commercial Rigid Hull Inflatable Boats as Technical Project Manager. Our client is seeking a dynamic and creative individual to manage technical configuration and generate technical documentation for custom military and professional watercraft. This position requires both technical and organizational skills.

Reporting to the Sales Director, responsibilities will include:
Technical Configuration Control:

  • Technical interface with the company’s global engineering departments in Canada, Spain, and France company locations.
  • Creating and maintaining 2D and 3D drawings for manufacturing and configuration approval.
  • Maintaining local technical library for Sales, Production, and Purchasing departments.
  • Creating and maintaining product technical marketing sheets.
  • Maintaining configuration library for previous RHIB proposals and deliveries.
  • Advising Purchasing department on product requirements.
  • Occasional direct interface with suppliers to verify product characteristics and requirements.
  • Technical training of the Sales and Production team when applicable.
  • Participating in product evolution, development, and testing.
Technical Sales Support
  • Maintaining price data for current products.
  • Interface between Sales and global Engineering departments, providing specification analysis and definition of the proposed product.
  • Interface with Sales team on the preparation of written price proposals.
  • Briefing Sales team on development of new equipment/options when applicable.
  • Participating with Sales team in customer meetings and marketing events.
Technical Project Support:
  • Maintaining manufacturing production schedule and coordinating with Purchasing, Production, and Shipping departments.
  • Communicating contract technical requirements to Purchasing, Production, and Shipping departments.
  • Support site quality assurance / quality control program.
  • Supporting customer visits during manufacturing process.
  • Supporting Sales and Training teams during factory tests, sea trials, and boat deliveries.
  • Follow-up and tracking of after-sales service and warranty technical issues.
  • Supporting Management team in evaluating revisions, schedules, and alternatives for active contracts. 
Marketing Support:
  • Developing and maintaining a photograph library and for electronic and printed marketing material.
Qualifications and requirements:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent.
  • General knowledge of the maritime industry is required.
  • Military and/or watercraft operating experience is a plus.
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD, Rhino7, SolidWorks, and other CAD software is required.
  • Computer skills: Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, Word) and Google Suite (Sheets, Docs)
  • Project Management experience is highly desired.
  • Some experience in Marketing or Sales is a plus.
  • Valid driver’s license - French or Spanish language skills a plus.
Physical Requirements:
  • This position involves occasional work on small watercraft in the manufacturing facility and on the water.
  • Climbing ladders, kneeling, bending, and the ability to work aboard boats of various sizes are required.
  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to travel in the U.S.


This challenging position will suit a well-organized and self-motivated candidate with outstanding oral &written communication skills. We are looking for a quick learner with a passion for high-performance watercraft and a strong ability to deal effectively with clients, management, sales, and technical staff. The ideal candidate will be able to work independently, create and maintain their own technical library system, and provide technical leadership throughout the design-sell-build process.
Long-term commitment necessary.

job.title: Director of Sales and Business Development
job.description:
Our International Client is seeking an experienced and dynamic Director of Sales and Business Development with a solid background in the commercial maritime industry. This role requires expertise in maritime electronics equipment, including navigation, communication, automation, and electrical systems. The Director of Sales will be responsible for developing and executing a strategic sales plan to drive business growth, focusing on acquiring new accounts and expanding our services across North America.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Strategy Development and Execution

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive sales strategy to drive revenue growth in Canada and the US, with a focus on acquiring new accounts and expanding the company's footprint.
  • Identify and prioritize target markets, segments, and customers, leveraging your knowledge of maritime electronics and understanding of industry needs.

Customer Acquisition and Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers in target organizations, demonstrating a deep understanding of their needs for navigation, communication, automation, and electrical systems.
  • Cultivate long-term partnerships with new accounts to drive customer satisfaction and retention, tailoring solutions to meet specific operational requirements.

Sales Pipeline Management and Reporting

  • Develop a robust sales pipeline, ensuring a steady flow of opportunities at all stages of the sales process.
  • Monitor and report on sales performance metrics, including lead conversion rates, deal sizes, and sales cycle length, providing regular updates to the executive team.

Collaboration and Team Leadership

  • Work closely with field service, marketing, and product teams to align sales efforts with product offerings and service capabilities in the maritime electronics sector.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop the sales team, fostering a high-performance, results-oriented culture and promoting knowledge sharing on commercial maritime electronics solutions.

Market Analysis and Competitive Intelligence

  • Conduct market research to stay informed on industry trends, competitive activity, and emerging opportunities in maritime electronics.
  • Gather and analyze feedback from customers, field staff, and industry sources to refine Alliance Nav’s sales approach and product development strategy.

Revenue and Budget Management

  • Set and achieve quarterly and annual sales targets, aligning with the company’s growth objectives.
  • Manage the sales budget, including expenses for travel, events, and initiatives supporting sales growth in the commercial maritime electronics field.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in a senior sales role within the commercial maritime industry, with strong knowledge of marine navigation, communication, automation, and electrical systems.
  • Track record of successfully driving revenue growth and acquiring new accounts in a technical or maritime electronics environment.
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to lead, inspire, and develop a high-performing sales team.
  • Experience collaborating across functions to achieve sales and business goals.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across Canada and the US as required.

Preferred Skills:

  • Deep understanding of the maritime industry’s unique needs, particularly related to electronics, automation, and communication systems.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, data analytics, and sales performance tools.
  • Ability to strategize and implement high-impact sales plans that respond to evolving market dynamics.

What You Get From Us

  • · A competitive and progressive salary
  • · A group insurance program
  • · A dynamic work environment
  • · 3 weeks of paid vacation

job.title: Quality Assurance Manager
job.description:
The Quality Manager for a Military Boat and Hull manufacturer is responsible for overseeing and managing all aspects of quality control within the manufacturing process. This includes establishing and maintaining quality standards for the production of the boats and hulls, conducting quality audits, and ensuring compliance with all relevant industry regulations.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Developing and implementing quality control processes to ensure that products meet customer requirements, company guidelines and regulatory standards
  • Liaise between vendor and supervisor for BOM adjustment during build in process
  • Conducting regular inspections and tests of materials and finished products to identify and resolve quality issues
  • Assist in development and maintenance of a Quality Management System (QMS) in accordance with ISO 9001:2015 standards
  • Collaborating with clients, vendors, Sales, production, and procurement teams to identify and address quality issues
  • Implementing corrective and preventive actions to prevent quality defects
  • Ensuring that all products meet customer specifications, safety and regulatory requirements
  • Monitoring and analyzing quality data to identify trends and areas for improvement
  • Collaborating with suppliers to ensure the quality of raw materials and components
Requirements:
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, quality assurance, related field or industry certifications / hands-on experience.
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in quality assurance, preferably in manufacturing or marine industries.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify defects or quality issues.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Knowledge of industry standards and regulations related to boats and rigid hull boats.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Certification in quality control or quality assurance is a plus.

job.title: Field Service Engineer - Florida, Mexican Gulf, or East Coast
job.description:
Marine Field Service Engineer needed ASAP!  Our client is seeking the best of the best to join and grow their International Operations in North America!  This position may be based anywhere on the Mexican Gulf, FL or the East Coast of the US.  It will be a traveling position with exciting perks and a prosperous future with a leader in the Marine Electronics field!
  • Install, repair and maintain marine navigation and communication equipment onboard vessels.
  • Hired candidate will be responsible for managing our clients' field service operations on the US-side of the Great Lakes and surrounding areas.
  • Use knowledge of electronic theory and circuitry to address a variety of technical problems.
  • Load and update of manufacturer’s software, backup computers, data retrieval.
  • Inspect, adjust, align, replace or repair electronic equipment, assemblies, and components following equipment manuals and schematics, using soldering tools, hand and power tools as well as electronic test instruments.
  • Fill out company service report and documentation.
  • Work under limited supervision.

Requirements:

  • Completion of a two- or three-year college program in electrical or electronics engineering technology, computer engineering technology, or an equivalent. Possession of higher education is a plus.
  • Must have 12-24 months of experience working as a Maritime Field Service Technician either in the U.S. Coast Guard, U.S. Navy, U.S. Marine Corps, commercial or fishing industry.
  • Computer networking knowledge (Ethernet, serial communications protocols).
  • Knowledge of marine navigation equipment including but not limited to radars, gyrocompasses, autopilots, ECDIS, GMDSS, etc.
  • Strong knowledge of electronics theory and application.
  • Basic AC/DC electrical theory.
  • Ability to use DVM, oscilloscope, and other test equipment.
  • Interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Be physically fit. Work environment often requires lifting equipment weighing up to 50lbs, climbing ladders and masts, working at heights and being exposed to unpredictable weather conditions.
  • Fluent in English (spoken & written).
  • Hold valid passport and driver’s license.
  • Authorized to work in the U.S.
  • Dependable and willing to work a flexible schedule including overtime.
  • Some travel required to job locations and training courses.

Employment conditions :

  • Full time position based on 37.5 hrs per week or regular time.
  • Candidate must be willing to work overtime and on weekends when necessary.
  • Annual base salary range is between $60,000 and $70,000 , commensurate with technician’s experience and capabilities.
  • Overtime work is required and is paid at 1.5x base hourly wage.
  • Healthcare stipend will be provided to help cover the employee's cost of health insurance.
  • You will also be entitled to a three-week vacation.

Employment location(s):

Candidate will be based somewhere in the Duluth, MN Area but will be required to travel across various bordering states such as Michigan, Pennsylvania, New York, Wisconsin, Ohio and Minnesota to board client vessels.

Job Type: Full-time

Salary: $60,000.00 - $70,000.00 per year

Benefits:

  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Referral program
  • Relocation assistance
  • Tuition reimbursement

Schedule:

  • Monday to Friday
  • On call
  • Overtime

Supplemental pay types:

  • Bonus opportunities

Work Location: On the road

job.title: Sales Executive
job.description:
Outside Sales Executive

The Outside Sales Executive will be responsible for direct sales and related business activities in a defined territory. The primary objective is to grow new business, gain market share and to expand the depth and breadth of relationships with existing customers in the territory.

  • Sales: Maritime Solutions, Communications, Products and Service.
  • Develop a territory and customer specific sales strategy to meet company goals and revenues.
  • Build relationships with customers to discover their business objectives.

  • Educate customers on new and existing products and solutions.
  • Locate and identify new opportunities.

  • B.A./ B.S. degree required
  • 10+ years demonstrated sales experience in telecommunication field
  • Maritime background preferred.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Working knowledge of MS Office applications including Outlook, Word, CRM and Excel.

  • Valid Passport without restrictions.
  • A willingness to embrace and live the core values of the Company

job.title: Aftermarket Service Technician
job.description:
Aftermarket Service Technician & Coordinator Job Description
JOB TITLE: Aftermarket Service Technician & Coordinator
REPORTING TO: Managing Director
POSITION TYPE: Full-Time
JOB SUMMARY:
  • To support the growth of our Aftermarket activity, we are looking at expanding the team with a new, motivated, and skilled technician with a strong customer-oriented mindset and organizational abilities.
  • The person in this role performs a wide variety of service and technical support tasks including the coordination of the same throughout the company, working out of the office and occasionally onboard vessels.
  • The position requires working in partnership with the rest of the US team and together with our overseas team to deliver high quality service to our customers and perform aftermarket activities like parts quotation, ordering and replenishing stock products, and direct tech support/service work, acting as our primary contact person for support requests.
  • This position is not a WFH job, job-specific training will be provided, both in a classroom setup and on the job.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Overall Duties
Develop deep technical knowledge of company products and services and be a reference for them within the company and on the US market.
Service and Tech Support Duties
  • Help our Tech Support Manager as needed in solving technical customer issues and working through support requests backlog.
  • Perform or coordinate warranty maintenance and other after-sales technical activities
  • Support clients ensuring the reliability and performance of the product.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues of our equipment Commission and Sea Trial our stabilization systems, bow thrusters, and steering systems in the US (mainly FL).
Parts Aftermarket Duties
  • Provide parts quotes and lead times, process paperwork required for new and repeat parts & service orders.
  • Work internally to identify required part numbers, with price and availability.
  • Instruct admin what parts to quote or invoice to the customers.
Supply Chain Duties
  • Manage parts and consumables inventory, both physically and in our ERP, in alignment with the Ops. Mngr.
  • Enforce Inventory Discipline with Service Manager / Team.
  • Issue and monitor Purchase Orders for parts to the mother company in Europe in the ERP system.
  • Manage and keep records of all service & parts transactions, terms, inventory etc.
  • Execute stocking strategies including returns and warranties, re-stockings, monitor and execute reorder points, coordinate inbound logistics in alignment with the Operations Manager.
  • Receive incoming shipments in the warehouse, both physically and in our ERP, unload and QC the products, put in stock including managing locations (forklift operation might be required).
  • Responsible for stock product integrity (including from theft).
  • Additional Duties Assigned and required.
KEY REQUIREMENTS:
  • Leisure-marine experience
  • Based in the Ft. Lauderdale area (must live within approx. 50 miles max of our office)
  • Able and willing to regularly travel locally to visit customers / vessels
  • Able and willing to travel nationwide and overnight
  • Able and willing to travel internationally on occasions
  • Appreciative of small company environment, including wearing many hats
  • Experience in relevant technical fields (mechanical, electrical, electronic, or similar) Strong problem-solver with deep team spirit
  • Customer-focused mindset
ADDITIONAL PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Basic understanding of commercial and accounting concepts and practices (revenues vs. margins, orders vs invoicing, pricing, etc.)
  • Navy background a plus Commercial Marine experience a plus
  • Experience working in international environment
  • JDE Software knowledge a real plus
PERSONAL SKILLS:
Service Oriented, Customer Oriented, Critical Thinking, Time Management, Active Listener, Teamwork Oriented, Technical Capacity, Multitasking, Establish and Maintain Interpersonal Relationships, Attention to Detail, Well Organized, Good Communicator, Self-starter and SelfDisciplined, Mission Oriented, Growth mindset, Good Team-worker, Good Writing Skills, Good computer skills, Able to thrive in a fast-paced environment, Customer-oriented attitude, Adaptable to change, Quality-driven
EDUCATION OR RELATED EXPERIENCE:
Five or more years’ marine service-related experience, or an associate's degree in marine technologies or engineering and 2 years’ work experience, or equivalent combination of education and hands-on experience. Electrical and/or automation background preferred.
REASONING COMPETENCY:
Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists, ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram or schedule form.
LANGUAGE COMPETENCY:
  • Fluent English language with ability to read & interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions and procedure manuals.
  • Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
  • Ability to speak effectively before groups of either customers, clients, or employees of organization.
  • Bilingual - Spanish language a plus.
MATHEMATICAL COMPETENCY:
  • Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume.
  • Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry.
COMPUTER COMPETENCY:
Basic computer skills, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint required. Knowledge of ERP and Inventory management programs highly desirable.
OTHER REQUIRED SKILLS:
Strong critical thinking skills – ability to apply logic and reasoning to identify and evaluate alternative solutions or approaches to problems; ability to apply good judgement in decision-making. Strong values and personal integrity.
TRAINING OR CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:
Valid Passport and Driver License, clean background record.
PHYSICAL DEMANDS:
Able to lift, do physical work, hold a wrench, and other warehouse-related physical activity.
OTHER REQUIREMENTS:
Drug-free, US Citizen or Permanent resident, legally able to work in the US
WHAT WE OFFER:
  • Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications
  • Benefits: laptop, mobile phone, and company vehicle for service operations
  • Continuous technical training and opportunities for internal growth
  • A dynamic, high-tech work environment
